title: I miss this tea company SO much!
text: They had the best teas around. I was getting three different boxes a month from them, and when they announced they were going out of business I bought $2k in teas.  I miss the surprises every month. I've tried other companies, but their teas simply aren't as good. Field to Cup introduced me to teas I never would have found, especially the very traditional regional teas. My husband was THRILLED to find some of the very rare teas he had never found outside of his home contry of India. We bought all we could of those ones before they were gone.  Our closet is now filled of huge cardboard boxes of teas, but I always feel sad when a bag runs out becuase I wont be having any more of that kind.
label: positive
